events.title: East Bay Bike Party
events.venue: Meets near an East Bay BART station (spot posted ~24h before the ride)
events.description: Monthly mobile social bike ride — every 2nd Friday, all year. Meet 7:30 PM, roll 8:00 PM. Start spot near an East Bay BART station, posted ~24h prior on the site + Facebook group. Free. Route ~10-15 mi with party stops; monthly theme.
